# SoraCombobox

A searchable single-select with local filtering or an asynchronous source.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | inputs |
| Import | `import { SoraCombobox } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraCombobox from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraCombobox'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/inputs/SoraCombobox.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/inputs/SoraCombobox.vue) |
| Generic | `T extends string \| number` |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `readonly SoraOption<TValue>[]` | `[]` | Options to filter locally. Ignored while `search` is provided. |
| `search` | `((query: string, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<readonly SoraOption<TValue>[]>)` |  | Asynchronous source. Called (debounced) with the typed text and an `AbortSignal` that fires when the request is superseded. Results that arrive out of order are discarded. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Label text. It is the accessible name of the control. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Helper text below the control, announced as its description. |
| `error` | `string \| readonly string[] \| null` |  | Error message(s). A non-empty value also marks the control invalid and is announced with it. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field as required: the native `required` attribute plus a decorative marker on the label. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control, with the native `disabled` attribute where the element has one. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the control invalid (`aria-invalid`) without showing a message. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `id` | `string` |  | Id of the native control. Generated (and stable) when omitted. |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the label for assistive technology but hides it visually. |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `'vertical'` | `horizontal` puts the label beside the control when the container is wide enough. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `true` | Show a button that clears the selection. |
| `filter` | `((option: SoraOption<TValue>, query: string) => boolean)` |  | Custom local filter. Default: case- and accent-insensitive "contains" on the label. |
| `displayValue` | `((value: TValue) => string)` |  | Text for a selected value that is not among the current options (async sources). |
| `debounce` | `number` | `200` | Milliseconds to wait after typing before calling `search`. |
| `controlAttrs` | `SoraControlAttrs` |  | Attributes, listeners and a `ref` callback for the native control, for example Formisch's `field.props`. |

## Models

| v-model | Type |  | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `TValue \| null` | required | The selected option's value, or `null`/`undefined`. Free text is never a value. |

## Attributes

class/style go to the root; every other attribute and listener (and `controlAttrs`) goes to the native control.

## Keyboard

- Arrow Down/Up open the popup and move the active option; Alt+Down opens without moving, Alt+Up closes.
- Enter selects the active option (and does not submit the form while the popup is open).
- Escape closes the popup; with the popup closed it clears the selection.
- Tab closes the popup and moves on. Typing filters and opens the popup.

## Accessibility

- APG combobox with list autocomplete: `role="combobox"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-activedescendant`; options are `role="option"` in a `role="listbox"`.
- DOM focus stays in the input. The popup is a manual popover in the top layer, anchored to the field.
- Result counts, loading and errors are announced through a polite live region.
- Superseded asynchronous requests are aborted and stale results are discarded.

## Styling

- `.sora-field`, `.sora-field__label`, `.sora-field__hint`, `.sora-field__error`
- `.sora-input.sora-combobox`, `.sora-combobox__popup`, `.sora-listbox`, `.sora-listbox__option`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/InputsDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/InputsDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid max-w-2xl gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
  <SoraCombobox
    v-model="fruit"
    :options="fruitOptions"
    :label="t('demo.fruit')"
    :placeholder="t('demo.search')"
    data-testid="combobox-local"
  />
  <SoraCombobox
    v-model="asyncFruit"
    :search="searchFruit"
    :label="t('demo.fruit.async')"
    :placeholder="t('demo.search')"
    data-testid="combobox-async"
  />
</div>
<p class="mt-2 text-sora-sm text-sora-muted" data-testid="combobox-value">
  {{ t('demo.selected', { value: String(fruit) }) }}
</p>
```
